a: အဝတ်မရှိသော၊ ကျယ်တုံးလုံးနေသော(တက္ကတွန်း)။

B:
niccela： niccela（ti）

[ni+cela]

K:
niccela：နိစေ္စလ（တိ）
[နိ+စေလ]
အဝတ်မရှိသော၊ ကျယ်တုံးလုံးနေသော （တက္ကတွန်း）။
DOP: cela ( sometimes ceḷa), n. ( and m. ?) [ S. cela], cloth; a garment ; Abh 290 (~am acchādanaṃ vatthaṃ); S V 440, 5 (āditte bhikkhave ~e vā sīse vā kiṃ assa karaṇīyan ti); Ap 364, 7 (~e va ḍayhamānamhi); Bv 1:22 (bhamenti ~āni ca ambare tadā); Vism 217, 4 (ādittaṃ ~aṃ vā sīsaṃ vā ajjhupekkhitvā pi bhāvanāvasena); Ps II 265, 6 (manussā ~āni telacāṭiyaṃ temetvā ukkā katvā); Sadd 353, 7 (dussaṃ acchādanaṃ vatthaṃ ~o, Ee so; Be, Ce ~aṃ); 436, 21 (~an ti vatthaṃ); — ifc see dhāti- ( sv dhātī ); — °’- aṇḍuka , n. , a roll of cloth ; M I 150, 17 (~ena ce pi sabrahmacārī āyasmantaṃ Puṇṇaṃ Mantāṇiputtaṃ muddhanā pariharantā labheyyuṃ dassanāya, Be, Ee so; Ce celaṇḍūkena; Se velaṇḍukena; Ps II 158, 28 foll. : ettha celaṃ vuccati vatthaṃ aṇḍukaṃ cumbaṭakaṃ, Ce, Ee so; Be aṇḍupakaṃ; Se velaṃ vuccati … aṇḍūpakaṃ); — °’- ukkhepa , m. , throwing up or waving of cloths ; Ja III 285, 16 (kammārasahassaṃ aṅguliyo poṭhesi ~ā pavattiṃsu); V 67, 16 (sādhukārasahassāni adāsi ~e ca aṅgulipoṭhe ca pavattesi); VI 156, 25* (~aṃ akaruṃ samāgatā rājaparisā ca; 157, 4´ foll. : nānāvaṇṇehi vatthehi dhaje ussāpetvā uttariyāni ākāse bhamentā ~aṃ kariṃsu); Ps II 195, 9 (ukkuṭṭhiyo c’ eva ~ā ca vattanti); — °- paṭikā , °-pattikā, f. [cela + paṭikā 1 ], a cloth covering; a length of cloth ; Vin II 128, 29 (saṃharantu rājakumāra dussāni, na bhagavā ~aṃ akkamissati, Be so; Se ceḷa-; Ce, Ee °-pattikaṃ; Sp 1209, 13 : ~an ti °-santharaṃ) = M II 93, 2 ( Be, Se so; Ce, Ee °-pattikaṃ); Dhp-a III 136, 3 (ummārato paṭṭhāya ~aṃ patthari, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee °-pattikaṃ); — acela , mf ( n )., unclothed, naked; a naked ascetic ; D I 161, 4 (~o Kassapo yena bhagavā ten’ upasaṅkami; Sv 349, 12 : ~o ti naggaparibbājako); III 6, 9 (~o Korakkhattiyo kukkuravatiko catukuṇḍiko …); S I 78, 2 (satta ca jaṭilā satta ca nigaṇṭhā satta ca ~ā satta ca ekasāṭakā …); Ja V 16, 3* (yaṃ ve pivitvā ~o va naggo, Be, Ee so; Ce, Se pitvā acelako va; 18, 24´ : acelako viya); 82, 20* (hitvā gharaṃ pabbajito ~o naggo muṇḍo carati ghāsahetu); Mp III 329, 15 (ekā micchādiṭṭhikā yakkhinī ~ā hutvā dve hatthe pasāretvā jivhaṃ nillāletvā …); Th-a II 118, 27 (varaṃ te bhikkhu … aṅgulīhi kese luñcitvā ~assa sato gūthamuttāhārajīvanan ti); — acelāya in Ee at Ps III 321, 6 is wr for avelāya ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — niccela , mfn. , without clothes ; Ps II 43, 26 (acelako ti ~o naggo); Spk II 34, 24 (acelo Kassapo ti liṅgena acelo ~o, nāmena Kassapo); — see also acelaka, sacelaka.
